build_box2box_transform: build a Box2BoxTransform with weights tuple to compute R-CNN box regression deltas between source and target boxes
build_rotated_box2box_transform: build a Box2BoxTransformRotated with 5-element weights to compute rotated box regression deltas including angle
test_get_deltas: test Box2BoxTransform get_deltas method to compute dx dy dw dh deltas from source to target boxes
test_apply_deltas: test Box2BoxTransform apply_deltas method to transform anchor boxes using predicted regression deltas
test_dense_box_regression_loss: test _dense_box_regression_loss to compute smooth_l1 or giou loss for multi-level anchor box regression
